faq.title: I see a transaction I did not make
faq.eligibility: Any customer reporting an unauthorised transaction.
faq.answer: Unauthorised transactions must be reported immediately. Reporting within 3 working days limits customer liability under the bank's fraud protection policy. The bank will block the affected card or channel and raise a dispute for investigation.
steps: Hand off to a human agent immediately.
Block the affected card or channel without delay.
Record the date, amount and merchant of each disputed transaction.
Raise a fraud dispute and share the reference number.
Advise the customer to also file a complaint on the national cybercrime portal or helpline.
required_documents: Police or cybercrime complaint copy (if requested by the fraud team)
faq.escalation_condition: Always escalate to the fraud team immediately.

faq.title: Money was debited but the transfer failed
faq.eligibility: Customers whose UPI, IMPS or NEFT transfer failed after the amount was debited.
faq.answer: When a transfer fails after debit, the amount is automatically reversed. UPI and IMPS reversals normally complete within 1 working day (T+1) and NEFT reversals within 2 working days. If not reversed in this time, a dispute can be raised with the transaction reference number.
steps: Note the transaction reference number (UTR / RRN) and date.
Check whether the reversal window (T+1 for UPI/IMPS, 2 working days for NEFT) has passed.
If the window has passed, raise a failed-transaction dispute with the reference number.
Share the dispute ticket number with the customer.
faq.escalation_condition: Escalate if the amount is not reversed 5 working days after the transaction.

faq.title: My card has not been received or was returned to the bank
faq.eligibility: Cards dispatched more than 10 working days ago, or cards returned undelivered by the courier.
faq.answer: If a card is not delivered within 10 working days of dispatch, or the courier returns it, the card is held at the issuing branch for 30 days and then destroyed. The customer can ask for re-dispatch to the registered address or collect it from the branch with photo ID.
steps: Confirm the registered address on the account is correct.
Raise a 'Card not received' service request.
Choose re-dispatch to the registered address or collection from the issuing branch.
If collecting from the branch, carry an original photo ID.
required_documents: Original photo ID (only for branch collection)
faq.escalation_condition: Escalate if tracking shows 'delivered' but the customer did not receive the card, because the card may need to be blocked.
